_approach: Drop-section kick with a stutter: straight 4/4 for seven beats then two 16th kicks on the end of bar 2 leading back to the downbeat, the pop-drop punctuation that short streaming edits lean on. Big clap 2 and 4, offbeat open hats. Reference: Creeds 'Push Up', Bennett. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
